body:
Merge class: SAME. The reviewed head is the merged head, `ca11cb86040dbec7529c3088fceb3a96e1899f13`. No commit came after it.

This merge relies on the safety-tier review by mkinney's review agent of 06:50 UTC on that head. The PR fixes a P3 (#2657) and touches no P1, so no second review is necessary.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ca11cb86040dbec7529c3088fceb3a96e1899f13 -->
Review of #2680, head ca11cb860. Built in a worktree: the head merged with current main (clean), then the touched suites and clippy ran.

Result: pass. No blockers.

What was run:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --test boundary_walls` and `-p camcraft-app --test face_rim_hole` - 6 + 2 tests, all pass.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --lib tangency` - the new unit pin passes.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test blind_floor --test contour_outside_hole --test face_holes --test face_stock_edge --test verify --test warned_moves` - 44 tests, all pass (2 ignored as on main).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` - clean.

What the review checked:
- The excuse cannot silence a real gouge: with a model, `tangency` reads the slice where the cutter is full radius; an unprovable slice (`Some(None)`) convicts before the edge filter runs. `Mode::Area` and no-model `Mode::Boundary` keep every region edge (pinned).
- A wall that stands above the cut plane is in `section`, and `section` edges stay checked unconditionally. The negative controls prove it: the move near the wall below the model top convicts at moves 0 and 1 and blocks the post with no file (lib pin, sim pin, app pin).
- `edge_is_wall` is the predicate `wall_gouge` used inline before; one extraction, both laws now share it. The probe is finite-safe (`len <= EPSILON` returns false).
- The pins are red-before, green-after, with a mutation restore of the upstream file (stated in the body).
- Decision entry names what was dropped and why (no Face-specific flag; the verifier stays operation-name independent).

Not P1: #2657 is P3. This changes a verdict, not posted G-code: a program that main refuses now posts, with the gouge law intact for walls.
